summary: This document is a 'Long Term Two Wheelers Bundled Policy' issued by National Insurance Company Limited. It combines Own Damage (Section I, 1 year extendable), Third Party Liability (Section II, 5 years), and Compulsory Personal Accident Cover for Owner-Driver (Section III, 5 years). The policy details coverage perils, exclusions, depreciation rates for parts and IDV, conditions for claims, and specific rules for obsolete vehicles. Key fields include insurer details, policy structure, coverage scope, depreciation schedules, IDV calculation methodology, and liability limits.
